# link strength

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:linkStrength`](gmeow-linkStrength.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/linkStrength>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A solver-INPUT weight for this link, on whatever scale the consuming analysis declares. Never a solver output written back as assertion ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). NOT functional design review: strength estimates are source-variable claims — divergent estimates coexist through the statement layer rather than forcing [owl:sameAs](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs) collisions; single-valuedness per base graph is the SHACL layer's job (the [`hasAuthorityLevel`](gmeow-hasAuthorityLevel.md) convention).
